description: A dark-haired man in classical Roman-style dress, a white head cloth with a gold band, a white draped toga-like tunic and a deep red mantle with gold trim, sits on a stone ledge bundling dried herb sprigs. Wicker baskets of roots, leaves and dried herbs sit on the ledge in front of him, with a small mortar-like vessel in the right basket. Behind him is a sunlit Mediterranean garden with an olive tree, flowering plants and weathered stone walls. A small white sparkle logo sits in the bottom-right corner; the painting fills the image edge to edge with no frame, no text and nothing graphic.
